notes: Published-comparison basis: the ATCR figures under 'published_expectations' are for the 10 MARKETING carrier networks (brand-level). This table is by OPERATING (reporting) carrier. OBSERVED GAP: December 2024 scheduled flights here = 590,581 vs ATCR's 631,944 marketing figure (-6.5%); the same ~6% gap appears in other months (e.g. April: 582,185 here vs 619,920). The marketing file additionally counts branded code-share flying operated by small partner carriers that do not report into this table, which accounts for the bulk of the count gap; the RATES (on-time %, cancellation %) are still directly comparable and are checked against ATCR's full-year figures (78.10% on-time arrivals, 1.4% cancelled) in the analysis. The gap is a scope difference between two BTS products, not a download defect: every file's SHA-256 matches the manifest, the January line/record check matches exactly, and the analysis's pandas counts reproduce these csv-module counts row for row.

Row counts here come from the csv module streaming the zips directly -- independent of the pandas load in the analysis script, which must reproduce the same per-month counts (the analysis records its loaded counts in outputs/metrics.json).
